name: cheetah_pup_assembly_v1
status: Original shaft-anchored assembly envelopes using manufacturer reference servo mass properties; not released manufacturing CAD or calibrated simulation.
frame: Body x forward, y left, z up; roll about +x, pitch and knee about +y; meters, kilograms, radians.
mass_notes: Total 0.613 kg remains a provisional budget. Twelve 18 g XL330 servo masses now use manufacturer reference COM/full tensors transformed into each parent frame, including knee casing tails below their shafts. Servo horn mass is lumped on housing parent; visible rotating horn is massless to avoid double counting. Printed-piece mass allowances distributed by envelope volume. Electronics/battery are size allowances, not selected parts.

actuator.model: ideal torque-limited position PD, for geometry and static screening only
actuator.notes: The 0.10 Nm value is a manufacturer-estimated continuous figure, not a thermal guarantee. Gains, damping and armature are arbitrary screening settings, not an identified XL330 model or BAM. Published BAM voltage/controller compatibility is still an open gate; do not use this model for sim-to-real training claims.

simulation.notes: Original boxes/cylinders with robot self contacts enabled, plus explicit adjacent motor/body pairs. Assembly audit separately checks signed distances including adjacent bodies. Carpet remains a rigid friction placeholder. Fastener fit, cable bend radii, support bearings and compliance remain unvalidated.

source_frame.origin: Center of stock output horn outer/front mounting face
source_frame.x: Right when looking at the output horn, with casing long direction down
source_frame.y: Toward the short top end of the casing above the output shaft
source_frame.z: Outward from the output horn toward the viewer

servo_reference.inertia_reference: About center of mass, expressed in source-frame axes; COM interpretation is inferred from physical consistency, since PDF table does not explicitly name tensor origin.

gait.notes: Revised geometric demonstration: shallower stance and smaller COM shifts pass sampled clearance checks. Not a dynamically validated walking controller. Original0.124m/full-centroid gait is retained as an explicit rejected regression case.
